record.bible_text: Comfort<WH05162><WTH8761> ye, comfort<WH05162><WTH8761> ye my people<WH05971>, saith<WH0559><WTH8799> your God<WH0430>.

The voice<WH06963> of him that crieth<WH07121><WTH8802> in the wilderness<WH04057>, Prepare<WH06437><WTH8761> ye the way<WH01870> of the LORD<WH03068>, make straight<WH03474><WTH8761> in the desert<WH06160> a highway<WH04546> for our God<WH0430>.

Every valley<WH01516> shall be exalted<WH05375><WTH8735>, and every mountain<WH02022> and hill<WH01389> shall be made low<WH08213><WTH8799>: and the crooked<WH06121> shall be made straight<WH04334>, and the rough places<WH07406> plain<WH01237>: <RF>straight: or, a straight place<Rf> <RF>plain: or, a plain place<Rf>

And the glory<WH03519> of the LORD<WH03068> shall be revealed<WH01540><WTH8738>, and all flesh<WH01320> shall see<WH07200><WTH8804> <FI>it<Fi> together<WH03162>: for the mouth<WH06310> of the LORD<WH03068> hath spoken<WH01696><WTH8765> <FI>it<Fi> .

The voice<WH06963> said<WH0559><WTH8802>, Cry<WH07121><WTH8798>. And he said<WH0559><WTH8804>, What shall I cry<WH07121><WTH8799>? All flesh<WH01320> <FI>is<Fi> grass<WH02682>, and all the goodliness<WH02617> thereof <FI>is<Fi> as the flower<WH06731> of the field<WH07704>:

The grass<WH02682> withereth<WH03001><WTH8804>, the flower<WH06731> fadeth<WH05034><WTH8804>: because the spirit<WH07307> of the LORD<WH03068> bloweth<WH05380><WTH8804> upon it: surely<WH0403> the people<WH05971> <FI>is<Fi> grass<WH02682>.
The grass<WH02682> withereth<WH03001><WTH8804>, the flower<WH06731> fadeth<WH05034><WTH8804>: but the word<WH01697> of our God<WH0430> shall stand<WH06965><WTH8799> for ever<WH05769>.<CM>

O Zion<WH06726>, that bringest good tidings<WH01319><WTH8764>, get thee up<WH05927><WTH8798> into the high<WH01364> mountain<WH02022>; O Jerusalem<WH03389>, that bringest good tidings<WH01319><WTH8764>, lift up<WH07311><WTH8685> thy voice<WH06963> with strength<WH03581>; lift <FI>it<Fi> up<WH07311><WTH8685>, be not afraid<WH03372><WTH8799>; say<WH0559><WTH8798> unto the cities<WH05892> of Judah<WH03063>, Behold your God<WH0430>! <RF>O Zion...: or, O thou that tellest good tidings to Zion<Rf> <RF>O Jerusalem...: or, O thou that tellest good tidings to Jerusalem<Rf>

Behold, the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069> will come<WH0935><WTH8799> with strong<WH02389> <FI>hand<Fi> , and his arm<WH02220> shall rule<WH04910><WTH8802> for him: behold, his reward<WH07939> <FI>is<Fi> with him, and his work<WH06468> before<WH06440> him. <RF>with strong...: or, against the strong<Rf> <RF>his work: or, recompence for his work<Rf>

He shall feed<WH07462><WTH8799> his flock<WH05739> like a shepherd<WH07462><WTH8802>: he shall gather<WH06908><WTH8762> the lambs<WH02922> with his arm<WH02220>, and carry<WH05375><WTH8799> <FI>them<Fi> in his bosom<WH02436>, <FI>and<Fi> shall gently lead<WH05095><WTH8762> those that are with young<WH05763><WTH8802>. <RF>that...: or, that give suck<Rf><CM>

Who hath measured<WH04058><WTH8804> the waters<WH04325> in the hollow of his hand<WH08168>, and meted out<WH08505><WTH8765> heaven<WH08064> with the span<WH02239>, and comprehended<WH03557><WTH8804> the dust<WH06083> of the earth<WH0776> in a measure<WH07991>, and weighed<WH08254><WTH8804> the mountains<WH02022> in scales<WH06425>, and the hills<WH01389> in a balance<WH03976>? <RF>a measure: Heb. a tierce<Rf>

Who hath directed<WH08505><WTH8765> the Spirit<WH07307> of the LORD<WH03068>, or <FI>being<Fi> his counsellor<WH0376><WH06098> hath taught<WH03045><WTH8686> him? <RF>his...: Heb. man of his counsel<Rf>

With whom took he counsel<WH03289><WTH8738>, and <FI>who<Fi> instructed<WH0995><WTH8799> him, and taught<WH03925><WTH8762> him in the path<WH0734> of judgment<WH04941>, and taught<WH03925><WTH8762> him knowledge<WH01847>, and shewed<WH03045><WTH8686> to him the way<WH01870> of understanding<WH08394>? <RF>instructed...: Heb. made him understand<Rf> <RF>understanding: Heb. understandings?<Rf>

Behold, the nations<WH01471> <FI>are<Fi> as a drop<WH04752> of a bucket<WH01805>, and are counted<WH02803><WTH8738> as the small dust<WH07834> of the balance<WH03976>: behold, he taketh up<WH05190><WTH8799> the isles<WH0339> as a very little thing<WH01851>.
And Lebanon<WH03844> <FI>is<Fi> not<WH0369> sufficient<WH01767> to burn<WH01197><WTH8763>, nor the beasts<WH02416> thereof sufficient<WH01767> for a burnt offering<WH05930>.
All nations<WH01471> before him <FI>are<Fi> as nothing; and they are counted<WH02803><WTH8738> to him less than nothing<WH0657>, and vanity<WH08414>.<CM>
To whom then will ye liken<WH01819><WTH8762> God<WH0410>? or what likeness<WH01823> will ye compare<WH06186><WTH8799> unto him?

The workman<WH02796> melteth<WH05258><WTH8804> a graven image<WH06459>, and the goldsmith<WH06884><WTH8802> spreadeth<WH07554><WTH8762> it over with gold<WH02091>, and casteth<WH06884><WTH8802> silver<WH03701> chains<WH07577>.

He that <FI>is<Fi> so impoverished<WH05533><WTH8794><WTH8676><WH05534><WTH8765> that he hath no oblation<WH08641> chooseth<WH0977><WTH8799> a tree<WH06086> <FI>that<Fi> will not rot<WH07537><WTH8799>; he seeketh<WH01245><WTH8762> unto him a cunning<WH02450> workman<WH02796> to prepare<WH03559><WTH8687> a graven image<WH06459>, <FI>that<Fi> shall not be moved<WH04131><WTH8735>. <RF>is so...: Heb. is poor of oblation<Rf>

Have ye not known<WH03045><WTH8799>? have ye not heard<WH08085><WTH8799>? hath it not been told<WH05046><WTH8717> you from the beginning<WH07218>? have ye not understood<WH0995><WTH8689> from the foundations<WH04146> of the earth<WH0776>?

<FI> It is<Fi> he that sitteth<WH03427><WTH8802> upon the circle<WH02329> of the earth<WH0776>, and the inhabitants<WH03427><WTH8802> thereof <FI>are<Fi> as grasshoppers<WH02284>; that stretcheth out<WH05186><WTH8802> the heavens<WH08064> as a curtain<WH01852>, and spreadeth them out<WH04969><WTH8799> as a tent<WH0168> to dwell in<WH03427><WTH8800>: <RF>It is...: or, Him that<Rf>
That bringeth<WH05414><WTH8802> the princes<WH07336><WTH8802> to nothing; he maketh<WH06213><WTH8804> the judges<WH08199><WTH8802> of the earth<WH0776> as vanity<WH08414>.

Yea, they shall not be planted<WH05193><WTH8738>; yea, they shall not be sown<WH02232><WTH8795>: yea, their stock<WH01503> shall not take root<WH08327><WTH8782> in the earth<WH0776>: and he shall also blow<WH05398><WTH8804> upon them, and they shall wither<WH03001><WTH8799>, and the whirlwind<WH05591> shall take<WH05375><WTH8799> them away as stubble<WH07179>.
To whom then will ye liken<WH01819><WTH8762> me, or shall I be equal<WH07737><WTH8799>? saith<WH0559><WTH8799> the Holy One<WH06918>.

Lift up<WH05375><WTH8798> your eyes<WH05869> on high<WH04791>, and behold<WH07200><WTH8798> who hath created<WH01254><WTH8804> these <FI>things<Fi> , that bringeth out<WH03318><WTH8688> their host<WH06635> by number<WH04557>: he calleth<WH07121><WTH8799> them all by names<WH08034> by the greatness<WH07230> of his might<WH0202>, for that <FI>he is<Fi> strong<WH0533> in power<WH03581>; not one<WH0376> faileth<WH05737><WTH8738>.<CM>

Why sayest<WH0559><WTH8799> thou, O Jacob<WH03290>, and speakest<WH01696><WTH8762>, O Israel<WH03478>, My way<WH01870> is hid<WH05641><WTH8738> from the LORD<WH03068>, and my judgment<WH04941> is passed over<WH05674><WTH8799> from my God<WH0430>?

Hast thou not known<WH03045><WTH8804>? hast thou not heard<WH08085><WTH8804>, <FI>that<Fi> the everlasting<WH05769> God<WH0430>, the LORD<WH03068>, the Creator<WH01254><WTH8802> of the ends<WH07098> of the earth<WH0776>, fainteth<WH03286><WTH8799> not, neither is weary<WH03021><WTH8799>? <FI>there is<Fi> no searching<WH02714> of his understanding<WH08394>.
He giveth<WH05414><WTH8802> power<WH03581> to the faint<WH03287>; and to <FI>them that have<Fi> no might<WH0202> he increaseth<WH07235><WTH8686> strength<WH06109>.
Even the youths<WH05288> shall faint<WH03286><WTH8799> and be weary<WH03021><WTH8799>, and the young men<WH0970> shall utterly<WH03782><WTH8800> fall<WH03782><WTH8735>:
